name: Should I choose a three-quarter or full bathroom for my ADU?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose a three-quarter or full bathroom for my ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision between a three-quarter (toilet, sink, shower) or full bathroom (toilet, sink, tub/shower combo) for your ADU depends on its intended use and available space. A full bathroom is often preferred for long-term rentals or larger ADUs, offering more amenities and potentially increasing rental appeal. A three-quarter bath is a space-efficient option for smaller ADUs or guest houses where a bathtub isn't a priority. Consider the overall footprint of the ADU and the preferences of potential occupants when making this choice.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a full bathroom for greater appeal and amenities in larger ADUs, or a space-saving three-quarter bath for smaller units or specific guest needs.
